actions.create_queue.description: Creates a standard or FIFO queue in the connection region.

actions.create_queue.props.tags.descript: Up to 50 key/value tags for cost tracking.

actions.receive_messages.description: Receives up to 10 messages from a queue. Received messages are hidden from other consumers until the visibility timeout ends; delete them after processing.
actions.receive_messages.props.includeAt: Return system attributes and message attributes.
actions.receive_messages.props.manualQue: Full queue URL, e.g. https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/my-queue. Overrides the Queue dropdown when filled.

actions.sendMessage.props.messageDedupli: FIFO only. Required unless content-based deduplication is on.
actions.sendMessage.props.messageGroupId: Required for FIFO queues. Same-group messages arrive in order.
actions.sendMessage.props.queueUrl.descr: The queue to use. If your access key cannot list queues, leave this empty and fill "Queue URL (manual)" instead.

triggers.new_message.description: Triggers for each new message in a queue. Messages are deleted from the queue once received by this trigger.
triggers.new_message.props.info.descript: Messages are **deleted from the queue** after this trigger receives them. Use a queue dedicated to this flow. Testing does not delete messages, but it does receive them, which increases their receive count. Repeated tests can move messages to a dead-letter queue if the queue has a receive limit.
triggers.new_message.props.manualQueueUr: Full queue URL, e.g. https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/my-queue. Overrides the Queue dropdown when filled.
triggers.new_message.props.queueUrl.desc: The queue to use. If your access key cannot list queues, leave this empty and fill "Queue URL (manual)" instead.
